_comment: bb-auth users file (JSON) — the REAL access gate (Cognito self-signup is open).
Re-checked on every /auth/validate, so removing a user + `systemctl reload bb-auth`
(SIGHUP) denies even existing sessions; a plain restart works too. Emails match
case-insensitively. Keys are addressed by `key_hash` = SHA-256 of the bbk_ bearer
(mint with tools/bb-apikey.py); the raw key is never stored here. `enabled_paths`
are request-path prefixes ([] or ['*'] = all paths); a key without them inherits
its user's scope. `duration`: <n>d / <n>h / 0 / never, counted from `released`.
Unknown fields (this _comment, per-key `notes`) are ignored, so use them freely.

api_keys.notes: example only — replace key_hash with one from tools/bb-apikey.py
